answer: Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the trellis of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing.
